description: Consultation from neighbouring authority London Borough of Barnet: reference 24/4556/FUL:  Demolition of the existing buildings and redevelopment of theWatling Avenue Car Park site including the erection of four buildings (6-13storeys) comprising no.344 residential units (Class C3) with roof terraces andexternal and internal amenity space, a new public park, 85 sqm of café (Class E)floorspace, 64sqm of co-working space (Class E), provision of 45 town centre carparking spaces and 10 blue badge spaces for future residents and improvedaccess. Demolition of the existing Library building and erection of a building (4storeys) to provide 348sqm commercial (Class E) floorspace at ground floor andno.15 residential units (Class C3) on upper levels and provision of one bluebadge parking space. Demolition of the buildings at 41 Barnfield Road anderection of a building (3 storeys) providing 1,230sqm floorspace for a new library,Council employment services and nursery (Use Class F1 and E), external amenityspace and provision of one blue badge parking space. Associated plant, access,refuse and recycling, cycle parking, amenity spaces, landscaping, play space andpublic realm works are also included
